resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Norwegian Bokmål source scope, prior review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Bokmål pass identified 25 actionable circuit, terminology, numeric-notation, thermal, SI, and wire-gauge defects; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Norwegian Bokmål human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff description was too vague about what is conserved.
evidence: The previous text referred generally to conservation in nodes and loops.
findings.resolution: Named charge conservation in nodes and energy conservation in closed loops.

findings.summary: The current-law example used less direct wording for solving the circuit.
evidence: The previous text used før du regner and a repetitive branch construction.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the example with øvrige grener, totalt, and før du løser kretsen.

findings.summary: The series-resistor setup used an awkward passive construction.
evidence: The previous setup said the resistors in series are connected to the source.
findings.resolution: Changed it to To motstander ... kobles i serie til en kilde.

findings.summary: The KVL formula used a decimal point in a comma-decimal locale.
evidence: The formula contained +8.0 V while surrounding Bokmål examples use comma decimals.
findings.resolution: Changed the formula to +8,0 V.

findings.summary: The parallel-cell sentence was less precise about retained voltage and summed capacity.
evidence: The previous sentence used beholder same voltage and an implicit subject for available current.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with same voltage, capacity, and available current as explicit subjects.

findings.summary: The cell-current sentence used a singular noun for a multi-cell system.
evidence: The sentence did not explicitly refer to the cells' internal resistance.
findings.resolution: Changed it to cellenes indre motstand and retained contacts, wires, and switches.

findings.summary: The TCR display name was less direct than the standard possessive technical form.
evidence: The previous name was Temperaturkoeffisient for motstand.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Motstandens temperaturkoeffisient (TCR).

findings.summary: The TCR example title was grammatically understandable but not specific about the temperature change.
evidence: The previous title was En oppvarmet motstand.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Motstand ved høyere temperatur.

findings.summary: The trigonometry example title did not say that the side is unknown.
evidence: The previous title was Finn en side.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Finn en ukjent side.

findings.summary: The angle-conversion formula used the English word radians.
evidence: The formula mixed Norwegian prose with the English unit word.
findings.resolution: Changed radians to radianer.

findings.summary: The electrical-heating heading was wordier than necessary.
evidence: The previous heading was Oppvarming med elektrisk effekt.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Elektrisk oppvarming.

findings.summary: The heat-flux example title did not use the density term.
evidence: The previous title said average heat flux from a heater.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Gjennomsnittlig varmeflukstetthet fra en varmeovn.

findings.summary: The heat-flux conclusion used heat flux rather than heat-flux density.
evidence: The previous conclusion named varmefluks despite reporting W/m² and W/cm².
findings.resolution: Changed it to varmeflukstetthet and retained both units.

findings.summary: The conduction bullet called heat flow strømning, which is less natural here.
evidence: The previous text used strømning for transfer through a layer.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as heat transfer from higher to lower temperature.

findings.summary: The convection paragraph called h an overflatekoeffisient rather than a convection coefficient.
evidence: The previous paragraph used the surface-coefficient term.
findings.resolution: Changed it to konveksjonskoeffisient h.

findings.summary: The SI display name used britiske måleenheter for the source's Imperial-units scope.
evidence: The previous display name narrowed Imperial units to British measurement units.
findings.resolution: Changed it to SI-systemet og imperiske enheter.

findings.summary: The SI description was generic and omitted derived units and decimal prefixes.
evidence: The previous description only said that SI provides a coherent basis for units and conversion.
findings.resolution: Named base units, derived units, decimal prefixes, and technical calculations.

findings.summary: The base-unit section heading said common SI units rather than SI base units.
evidence: The heading did not distinguish base units from derived units listed below.
findings.resolution: Changed it to SI-basisenheter.

findings.summary: The length-conversion heading used an awkward singular/plural mix.
evidence: The previous heading was Tommer og metrisk lengde.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Tommer og metriske lengder.

findings.summary: The wire-gauge display name used tråd, which is less general than ledning for the catalog scope.
evidence: The previous name was Tråddimensjoner.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Ledningsdimensjoner while retaining AWG, SWG, and BWG.

findings.summary: The wire-gauge description did not warn that the same number varies by system.
evidence: The previous text only said that systems describe diameter and area in different ways.
findings.resolution: Clarified that a gauge number is nominal only when the system is specified.

findings.summary: The AWG inch formula used a decimal point in a comma-decimal locale.
evidence: The formula contained 0.005 while surrounding Bokmål numeric prose uses comma decimals.
findings.resolution: Changed 0.005 to 0,005.

findings.summary: The AWG millimetre formula used a decimal point in a comma-decimal locale.
evidence: The formula contained 0.127 while surrounding Bokmål numeric prose uses comma decimals.
findings.resolution: Changed 0.127 to 0,127.

findings.summary: The wire-resistance paragraph overstated the size of a diameter difference as moderate.
evidence: The source concept describes a small diameter difference producing a significant resistance difference.
findings.resolution: Changed moderat forskjell to liten forskjell.

findings.summary: The practical wire specification used the generic strømkapasitet term.
evidence: The context is the safe current-carrying capability of a conductor.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the more precise strømføringsevnen.
